newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia wool indicator holds steady at 660c/kg.
newsitem.headline: Australia wool indicator holds steady at 660c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator was unchanged at 660 cents a kg clean on Tuesday at sales in Sydney and Adelaide, Wool International said.

Merino fleece was mixed, with 19/26 microns one percent dearer, 20m 0.5 percent dearer, 21m slightly dearer, 22/23m 0.5 percent cheaper, 24m one percent cheaper and 25m unchanged, while merino skirtings were generally unchanged.
In crossbreds, 27/28/30/31m were unchanged, with 29m slightly cheaper.
WI said Japanese interests including China were principal buyers with strong support from local mills and Taiwan.
Of the 26,019 bales offered, 10.1 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Wedneday in Sydney, Adelaide and Fremantle with about 44,250 bales to be offered.
